name: Solcito Tacos
tagline: A little sunshine. In every taco.
about: Warm tortillas, bright salsas, and something slow-cooked with love. Your little neighborhood stop for big flavor and good company.

services.name: Al pastor
services.description: Marinated pork, pineapple, onion, and cilantro on a warm corn tortilla.

services.name: Carne asada
services.description: Grilled steak, fresh onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

services.name: Roasted mushroom
services.description: Smoky mushrooms, avocado, pickled onion, and salsa verde.

services.name: The sunshine plate
services.description: Your choice of three tacos with rice, beans, and house salsa.

services.name: Chips & guacamole
services.description: Crisp tortilla chips and freshly mashed avocado. Made for sharing.

services.name: Agua fresca
services.description: A rotating fruit refresher. Ask about today’s flavor.
